Backend: Express API in `backend/` (`backend/index.js`); routes `backend/src/routes/`, controllers `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories `backend/src/repositories/`, switched by `RepositoryFactory` (JSON/Mongo). Menus use multer `upload.single("image")`. Frontend: React in `frontend/`; admin UI `frontend/src/pages/admin/`; client `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses `fetch`, `credentials: 'include'`, detects `FormData` (do not set `Content-Type` manually). Storage/config: `backend/.env`, `IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`; JWT/httpOnly-cookie auth.

Read `backend/src/routes/*.js`, `backend/src/controllers/*`, `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`, `backend/.env.examples`, `frontend/src/lib/api.js`, `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`. frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData. Setting `Content-Type` manually will break boundary generation. Tests: `backend/src/__tests__`, `supertest`, `backend/index.js`.
